call_questions: If 8% of your student borrowers default next semester, whose P&L takes the loss, and what does your contract with the NBFC say exactly?
What default and repayment data do you have so far, by cohort?
How do you collect from a student who has graduated and moved city?
Who on the team will own credit risk, and when will you hire them?
You told us defaults are something the NBFC handles - suppose the NBFC drops you after a bad cohort; what is left of the business?
what_would_change_our_view: A credit-risk owner on the founding team, repayment and default data on the first cohorts, and a plan in which the company holds and manages some default risk rather than passing it to the NBFC.
